title: AeroElast validation bibliography entry
description: One canonical, auditable reference. docs/validation/references.yaml is the rector; docs/references.md is generated from it. Field rules that need cross-file context (citation-key resolution, declared-vs-found citation diffing, .sources/ absence) are enforced by tools/validation_matrix.py 'check', not by this schema.

key.description: Stable join key. Matrix rows cite it via reference.citation; docs/references.md groups by it.

section.description: Bibliography section title, e.g. '1. Shell element formulations'. Replaces the old section-number pointer, which renumbering silently broke.

authors.description: Verbatim as printed, 'Family, G.' form. Empty is allowed only when 'authors' is declared in bibliographic_gaps: an absence is recorded, never left implicit.

year.description: Null only with 'year' in bibliographic_gaps. Software usually has no publication year and pins its identity with 'version' instead.

version.description: The version that pins a software entry's identity, e.g. 'v2406' or '4.2.1'. Required when kind == software and year is null.

bibliographic_gaps.description: The fields the source does not state. A field named here must actually be absent, and a required field that is absent must be named here: the store never invents a year, an author or a title to satisfy a validator.

doi_status.description: verified and printed_on_pdf require a conforming doi, held: true and a non-empty verification_note. not_applicable covers report numbers, proprietary manuals and journals registering no DOI, and requires notes.

held_files.description: Paths under .sources/, which is gitignored: absence in a fresh clone is a warning, never a failure.

verification.description: The convention docs/references.md states in prose today.

verification_note.description: What exactly was read off the held copy: authors, title, journal, volume, year, printed DOI, page count.

cited_by_declared.description: The audited claim carried over from the current prose ('Cited by the code: file:line'), kept only when it still verifies. Diffed by check against cited_by_found.

cited_by_stale.description: Sites the prose claims but the code no longer supports. Kept visible here instead of being dropped or stored as if true; `references check` reports each one as a warning.

code_mentions.description: The literal strings the code uses when citing this work, e.g. 'Ko2017'. cited_by_found is derived from these, because the code cites author-year text and never the store's key; without them every declared site would read as a false mismatch.

orphan_ok.description: A reference neither cited by a matrix row nor present in cited_by_declared must set this with a reason in notes.
